delivered: AssetLease batches preserve typed input order and duplicate addresses; each request independently owns a retainer reference.
A single default 15000ms deadline covers bundle and asset loading; in-flight AbortSignal cancellation, failure and timeout promptly drain acquired references.
Late successes acquire/release their own reference, preserving successful concurrent requests and retries. Successful batches require explicit release after render references retire.
Cocos adapter uses getBundle/loadBundle and typed Bundle.load for both resources and package bundle names, without removing shared bundle caches.
Idempotent and reentrant-safe release drains all holds even if one decRef fails; primary failures preserve cleanup errors, and late cleanup failures use an injected observer.
